subject: Next steps: Procurement route & timeline — security, legal, finance
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + procurement route options

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so procurement can line up resources: 

1) Commercial path options we discussed (please confirm preferred):
   - Card (self-serve) for immediate pilot (low friction, credit card).
   - PO / Purchase Order (monthly invoicing) for enterprise billing and finance approvals.
   - Marketplace listing (AWS/Azure/GCP) if you want a procurement-friendly marketplace SKU and consolidated billing.

2) Typical internal milestones we see at customers (recommended ordering for AtlasHealth):
   - Legal review of Master Services Agreement (MSA) — 1–2 weeks initially, then concurrent redlines.
   - Security questionnaire + evidence (SOC2 artifact, data flow diagram) — security may need 1–3 weeks depending on items asked.
   - Finance approvals (procurement + payment method confirmation) — 1 week after PO terms agreed.
   - PO issuance and account provisioning — immediately after finance sign-off.

3) Action items / mutual action plan (MAP):
   - Rafael: share MAP template + SOW draft (attached).
   - Marissa: prepare commercial summary and options for card vs PO vs marketplace.
   - Daniel: confirm procurement route preference and who on your side will own legal/security/finance follow-ups.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx, SOW-draft-AtlasHealth-20260630.pdf

Proposed timeline if you choose PO route: legal + security parallel -> finance approval -> PO issued (target: ~3–5 weeks). If you want to move faster, card pilot typically reduces to days for provisioning.

Suggest we reconvene next Tuesday 6/30 to check progress — does 11am PT work for you?

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
r.mendes@redwood.ai
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlashealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement route options

Rafael —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from procurement/finance side:

- Our finance team prefers PO for anything beyond $25k annualized; small pilots we can do on card. This engagement likely lands above that threshold if we move to the pilot scale you showed.
- We are interested in marketplace SKU if it simplifies internal billing and reduces vendor onboarding tasks; can Redwood provide marketplace pricing and lead times?
- Security wants a short intake form answered (we use a vendor risk portal) and will require SOC2 Type II evidence and network diagram. Who is our contact at Redwood for security artefacts?

I'll loop in Procurement and Legal if needed, but I wanted to confirm: is the SOC2 evidence publicly hosted or provided by request? Also, can you share a sample redline window for the MSA (how quickly does Redwood turnaround)?

Thanks — I'll try to get a procurement owner assigned by tomorrow.

Best,
Daniel Park
Director, IT Procurement | AtlasHealth
daniel.park@atlashealth.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement route options

Daniel —

Great — answers below and a couple of concrete next steps so we can keep procurement moving: 

- SOC2 evidence: we host a read-only SOC2 report portal for signed NDA/SLA customers; we can also provide scoped excerpts on request. I will put Vivek (security lead) on copy to coordinate delivery.
- MSA redline cadence: typical initial turnaround on standard redlines is 3–5 business days from Legal receiving the proposed redlines; if there are material novel clauses (data residency, indemnity tiers) it can take a bit longer. We aim to be responsive and will parallelize with security when possible.
- Marketplace: we have active listings on AWS Marketplace with ISV contracts; lead time to get a recorded SKU is typically 2–4 weeks depending on paperwork. Marissa will surface the commercial delta for marketplace pricing vs direct PO.

Proposed immediate asks from AtlasHealth so we can produce a tailored MAP and timeline:
  • Confirm preferred billing route (Card / PO / Marketplace)
  • Share primary legal contact + procurement contact (name + email)
  • Confirm security intake portal link when it arrives so Vivek can start mapping artifacts

I'll attach the MAP template again and a draft SOW for review. If you prefer, we can lock the pilot on a card for first 30 days and then move to PO for production — that is a common two-step path.

Next check-in meeting: Tue 30 Jun at 11:00am PT — we can use that slot to review any redlines and the security intake items. If that works, please let me know and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Rafael
